header.name: User Experience Design of XR
header.description: This course covers the user experience (UX design) fundamentals for XR (i.e., Augmented / Virtual/ Mixed Reality). Aspects related to the human-centered design process, 3D interactions and Interface Design, and human-factors issues associated with XR will be discussed. The course will briefly cover the development of AR/VR applications using Unity. This hands-on, project-based course with an emphasis on prototyping, testing, and evaluating the XR applications.
prerequisites_desirable: Skills: Programming, 3D modeling, Unity or Unreal, Electronics Prototyping, Figma/Adobe XD/ Sketch (having these skills will be advantageous but is not mandatory. The course is open for all skillsets)

A laptop/ computer that supports Unity, Unreal, and Blender. For in-class activities, you will be required to acquire various materials for Lo-Fi prototyping techniques. Some of these may include, Paper, Charts, Play Dough, etc.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to identify basic XR principles, recognize various XR devices, and gain an understanding about getting started with designing for user experience centered around XR

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to apply HCI and human-factors guidelines for designing usable, user-friendly, and useful XR user experiences. They will develop an understanding about utilizing various XR devices for specific use-cases. Students will gain a good understanding of UX research for XR application design

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to examine analyse various usability and design dimensions of XR experiences. Gain hands-on experience with XR hardware and creating working prototypes. Become capable of designing XR experiences

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to critically and scientifically evaluate the user experience design of XR applications.

lecture_topics: Team Formation and Project Idea Generation for Mid-sem Project (AR/MR application)
Introduction to 3D User Interaction and Interface Design
Getting Started with Augmented Reality Prototyping techniques for AR/ MR/VR (Lo-Fi prototyping)
Prototyping techniques for AR (Hi-Fi prototyping, Unity, Vuforia)
Getting to know AR/MR Hardware (Hololense, iPad, Leap motion, Manus Gloves, depth sensors, iPad, Android Tablets - subject to availability)
Prototyping AR/ MR in Unity, Vuforia [VR Lab]
Human-Factors of AR/MR 3D UIs (Information Processing, Perception)
Discussion on Minor Project + Mid-Sem report Submission and Presentation
Midsem Week + Break Week (Brainstorm Ideas for Major Project)
